about: Double Ratchet v2 script (design.md §3.3, §3.4, §3.6) generated by scripts/gen-vectors-v2.mjs. Run the steps in order with one scripted-randomness queue holding the draws in seq order; every encrypt must give the listed bytes and every decrypt the listed plaintext; state_after is the state serialized as design.md:208 describes. save_and_reload steps serialize and deserialize through the public serializers. m3 carries a filled grp slot. Refusal vectors use ordinary randomness; each must fail with expected_code (null: any typed refusal) and leave state_before unchanged.

kdf_rk.cite: design.md:172 (§3.3 item 3); DR §3.1 (KDF_RK returns a pair (32-byte root key, 32-byte chain key)), DR §5.2

kdf_ck.cite: design.md:173 (§3.3 item 4); DR §3.1 (KDF_CK returns a pair (32-byte chain key, 32-byte message key))

parameters.aead: XChaCha20-Poly1305 under mk, a random 24-byte nonce carried in the header, the 16-byte tag appended
parameters.header: [2, "xchacha20poly1305", nonce (bstr 24), dev_sender (bstr 16), dev_recipient (bstr 16), dh_pub (bstr 32), pn (uint), n (uint), grp]; grp = null | [gid (bstr 16), epoch (uint)]; shortest-form CBOR, no tags
parameters.labels: secret(label) = SHA-256(UTF-8(prefix || label)); a draw of n <= 32 bytes is the first n bytes of secret(label); longer data is secret(label + "/0") || secret(label + "/1") || ... cut to length

setup.what: X3DH without a one-time prekey from the same parties as x3dh-v2.json; the ratchet starts from sk and ad. A test that bootstraps through X3DH instead draws the EK below first.

stored_skipped_keys.stored_by: SkipMessageKeys(state, header.pn) before the DH step: the previous receiving chain up to pn (Double Ratchet §3.5)

steps.skipped_key_stored_by: SkipMessageKeys(state, header.pn) before the DH step: the previous receiving chain up to pn (Double Ratchet §3.5)
